gbm_trial_classes_8d_v1.resolution_note: In 8d_vector_run_results.json, full_alignment stores unnormalized p_i * t_i (not p_i * t_i / ||t||_2). Dividing full_alignment by p_i across all 3 patient profiles recovers exact t and reproduces all 18/18 reported fit scores to 4 decimal places.

secondary_atr_ddr_and_ceacam5_rescue_in_.note: Evaluates secondary ATR/DDR rescue eligibility among the 327 Gate-2 Immune-Cold non-POLE MSS CRC patients (and all 485 MSS patients) without altering the primary 8-trial Mode iii-C rankings.

ceacam5_adc_rescue_gate_requirements.expression_gate_required: CEACAM5 IHC >= 2+/3+ in >= 80% of tumor cells (per CARMEN-LC03 >=80% subgroup OS HR=0.71 vs 50-79% OS HR=1.02) + serum cCEA >= 100 ng/mL
ceacam5_adc_rescue_gate_requirements.payload_resistance_gate: Must not be prior-irinotecan/SN-38 refractory when using SN-38 payload (IMMU-130 NCT01270698 ORR 1.2% in irinotecan-refractory mCRC) and requires low efflux (p_efflux <= 0.15; 178/327 = 54.43% of Gate-2 Cold non-POLE MSS patients have p_efflux <= 0.15)
ceacam5_adc_rescue_gate_requirements.tcga_coadread_status: CEACAM5 IHC H-score / % 2+/3+ membrane staining is not present in the 485-row genomic CSV; requires IHC/RNA companion gate prior to ADC routing.
